title: riskell registry listing for a built-in atom
description: Metadata that points at an atom's source. For a built-in atom the source is in the riskell repository (listings/<id>.json). `riskell --list-atoms` and scripts/listings-check.sh keep these in step with the app.

id.description: The atom id as placed in a layout.

source.description: Files in the repository that make the atom, its card and its service.

home.description: package: already moved out (a package in this repository, installed by extensions.lock.json). app: stays in the application (it needs internals the kit does not expose). kit: can move out as a package once the kit's feeds carry what it reads.
